phase_L.center_when_a_minus_b_eq_1: emit 2 to (a-1,b+1); initialize right residual sigma=rho+9*b+3
phase_L.zero_center_transition: if an ordinary L step lands on a=b, normalize immediately to phase R with sigma=rho+9*b+3 without consuming another turn

phase_R.sector_finish: when the emitted edge lands at a=0, the resulting state is normalized to the next sector anchor (k+1 mod 6,L,r,0,-4); this normalization is not an extra turn

right_residual_derivation.midline_conversion: sigma=rho+9*b+3 in both the a=b no-center case and the a-b=1 center case

termination.left: d=a-b decreases by 1 on symbol 1 and by 2 on symbol 2 until d in {0,1}
termination.right: a decreases by exactly 1 on every emitted right-half edge until a=0
